description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of two models—TEXTBLOB and VADER—across two tweet categories: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet,” with the latter further subdivided into “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis.” The vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.2, while the horizontal axis categorizes the tweet types. For “Emoji Tweets,” TEXTBLOB (white bar with diagonal stripes) achieves approximately 0.35 accuracy, while VADER (solid green bar) reaches about 0.65. In the “Overall Tweet” category, TEXTBLOB’s accuracy drops to roughly 0.25, whereas VADER maintains a high accuracy of approximately 0.65. The chart visually emphasizes VADER’s superior performance across both categories, particularly in emoji-containing tweets, and includes a shaded green background behind the “Overall Tweet” group to highlight that segment. The legend clarifies the model representations, and the chart’s title suggests the context is sentiment analysis using ChatGPT as an annotation tool.
